description: When a European mountain pass (Alps, Norway, Carpathians…) usually opens and closes, whether it opened this year, night closures, and where the road operator publishes live status. Search by pass name or country. Seasons are records of past years, not live status; each result links to the operator's live status.

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.

name.description: Pass name or part of it, e.g. "Trollstigen", "Stelvio".

travel_date.description: When the user will drive (YYYY-MM-DD), to check seasonal passes. Default today.

name: get_mountain_pass
title: Mountain pass season
